// Propagates a fraction of a source bone's twist about an axis onto another
// bone; used for forearm and neck twist distribution. Axis is expressed in the
// source bone's local space.
type TwistConstraint
    implements IValue
{
    Bone: BoneIndex;
    SourceBone: BoneIndex;
    Axis: Vector3D;
    Fraction: Proportion;
}
